senses.gloss: m. (גלב, v. Fl. to Levy Targ. Dict. II, p. 567ᵃ) [scraper,] an instrument of torture, goad or whip.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 41">Gen. R. s. 41</cite>, beg.; s. 52; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 69">Yalk. Gen. 69</cite> <cite ref="M00183"><he>מגלבה</he></cite>; (Tanḥ. Lekh. 5 <cite ref="U01920"><he>שרביט</he></cite>).—Pl. <he>מַגְלָבִים</he>, <he>מַגְלָבִין</he>.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 14:1">Ex. R. s. 14</cite>, beg. <he>לך והכהו המשים מ׳</he> go and give him fifty lashes. Tanḥ. M’tsora 4 <he>כבלים ומ׳</he> chains and straps; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 13:15">Num. R. s. 13</cite>.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10">Num. R. s. 10</cite>, beg.; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 27">Lev. R. s. 27</cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:16">Cant. R. to V, 16</cite>, v. <cite ref="M02619"><he>מַרְזוֹבוֹת</he></cite>.
